novelty_method: The complete 3690-label chain was reconstructed from the immutable 3530-row Neris index, seven exact twenty-row freezes through Sable v662-v8 and Caelen's exact twenty-row v663-v1 freeze. Historical title-or-description fields were normalized under explicit UTF-8. Exact collision, token-neighbour and domain-keyword review rejected seed libraries and banks, herbarium, floristry, chess, handloom, cave survey, musical-instrument conservation and other inherited practice domains. Choir, choral and singing practice terms had no inherited practice-lens collision. Shared identity, correction, accessibility, workload, GMUT, THOS, Freed ID, zero-row and CBR patterns remain disclosed structural neighbours rather than novelty credit. Selected inherited rows remain zero-credit context.
selection_credit: Twenty Caelen rows are selected for boundary revalidation only. They receive zero Orin novelty, execution or completion credit.

new_proposals.title: Synthetic community-choir rehearsal-packet identity, revision, source-pin, cancellation, and performance-refusal capsule
new_proposals.hypothesis: A bounded validator can require a surrogate packet token, declared revision and source pin, explicit cancellation state and false performance authorization without containing lyrics, score excerpts or a real event.
new_proposals.null_or_failure: A raw person or choir identity, missing revision, unpinned source, ambiguous cancellation or performance authorization passes.
new_proposals.acceptance_or_falsifier: Only a fictional packet with explicit revision, source, cancellation and no-performance fields passes.
new_proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Reject and retain the fixture at zero credit; change no real choir, person, repertoire, venue, schedule, right or authority state.

new_proposals.title: Choir voice-section, singer-token, seat-group, substitute, vacancy, and real-identity quarantine topology
new_proposals.hypothesis: A declaration-only topology can require fictional section and singer tokens, known group links and explicit vacancies while rejecting real names, contacts and inferred vocal classification.
new_proposals.null_or_failure: A duplicate token, unknown section, raw identity, contact detail or vocal-classification claim passes.
primary_source_needs: Privacy Act source identity for reservation only
new_proposals.acceptance_or_falsifier: Unique surrogate tokens, known section links and explicit vacancy status pass only when all real identity fields are absent.
new_proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Reject and retain the fixture; collect no real member data and make no vocal placement decision.

new_proposals.title: Rehearsal-item, warm-up placeholder, repertoire-token, dependency, sequence, duration-budget, and incomplete-item tribunal
new_proposals.hypothesis: A bounded sequence validator can enforce unique fictional items, acyclic prerequisites, positive declared duration budgets and visible incomplete work without supplying vocal exercises or directing a real rehearsal.
new_proposals.null_or_failure: A dependency cycle, unknown item, nonpositive duration, real repertoire excerpt or rehearsal instruction passes.
new_proposals.acceptance_or_falsifier: Only a finite acyclic fictional schedule with positive budgets, no content and explicit incomplete states passes.
new_proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Reject and retain the fixture; schedule no real person or event.

new_proposals.title: Score-cue, edition-token, measure-reference, page-reference, rehearsal-mark, annotation, correction, and content-excerpt refusal grammar

new_proposals.acceptance_or_falsifier: Only tokenized references with no musical content and explicit authenticity and rights abstention pass.
new_proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Reject and retain the fixture; publish or copy no score, lyric, audio or video.

new_proposals.title: Tempo, metre, beat-unit, duration-placeholder, finite-range, clock-source, uncertainty, and performance-inference firewall

new_proposals.null_or_failure: NaN, infinity, Boolean numeric values, nonpositive tempo or duration, unsupported units, absent uncertainty or performance judgement passes.
new_proposals.acceptance_or_falsifier: Finite positive placeholders and declared uncertainty pass only with no real performance inference.
new_proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Reject and retain the fixture; measure or judge no real performance.
